projects.name: Stealth AI startup
projects.text: Agents that notice when a third-party API changes under you, then draft the pull request that fixes your code. A human still reviews it before it merges.

projects.name: InfraChat
projects.text: Ask the Kubernetes and Docker docs a question and get an answer with citations, or an honest "I don't know." Every retrieval component had to earn its place with a number.

images.alt: Bar chart of retrieval metrics for baseline, reranker, and hybrid search

projects.name: system-design-maker
projects.text: Describe a system in a few lines of text, see it drawn as a diagram, then send requests through it and watch them flow.

images.alt: system-design-maker editor: a microservices system written as text on the left, drawn as a diagram on the right

projects.name: QLoRA fine-tuning
projects.text: Reimplemented LoRA and QLoRA from scratch and fine-tuned GPT-2 and GPT-Neo while training less than 1% of the parameters. Perplexity on Wikitext dropped from 54.3 to 31.6.

images.alt: Training loss falling from 3.5 to 0.2 over 200 steps
